workbook_ambiguity.ambiguity: Workbook text says 44 flies, then 22 flies and two trials. Do not treat 44 files as 44 independent animals.
workbook_ambiguity.resolution: 22 animal IDs / two filenames each plus paper Fig3h/i and ExtendedData8 counts 5+7+5+5 =22, two recordings each, establish the usable 22-animal/44-recording dictionary.
workbook_ambiguity.limitation: No author erratum located; contradictory wording retained, evidence resolves counting interpretation rather than altering the workbook.

sampling.scope: Individual Fig3/Ext8 arrays only; no embedded dt/time vector.

onset.time_zero: Published stimulus onset, not NeuroFly scientific time zero.

preparation.compartment: GF soma in explicitly referenced acquisition protocol
preparation.compartment_provenance: publication_2025 Electrophysiological recordings → reference57 Jang2023 Electrophysiology; per-file deviation not documented.
preparation.amplifier: MultiClamp700B in referenced method; per-file settings UNKNOWN
preparation.temperature: Recording temperature not explicitly established for these files; rearing 25 C is not recording temperature.

stimulus.display: 4.5-inch mylar cylindrical display, 180-degree azimuth via two DLP projectors in published Fig3 method.
stimulus.full_selected_trial_geometry: Exact selected azimuth/elevation/initial-final angle and photodiode mapping need file-specific confirmation; do not automatically import previous-protocol stimulus values.
stimulus.population_context: Null mutation or GF-targeted RNAi modifies pathway context; source LC4/LPLC2 activity is not measured or controlled in model-state units.

filter_components.reason: Amplifier model in referenced method, no raw-file gain/filter settings.
20 kHz directly declared in dataset workbook.
Jang protocol describes analysis smoothing; does not establish that these MAT bytes received it.
Paper states two-recording animal means for Fig3 and five-trial summary context for Fig1; not a statement about stored arrays.

compatible_target.reason: Identified GF at neuron-type level; exact MaleCNS body identity not claimed.

baseline.reason: Individual-file dictionary declares 2 s prestimulus data; stored baseline-subtraction status is still undocumented.

relative_voltage_deflection.reason: Baseline period exists but stored scale and previous subtraction/offset transformations are not author-defined.

time_axis.reason: 20 kHz and 80,000 samples/4 s explicitly documented and structurally consistent; no resampling.

shared_stimulus_reference.reason: Workbook declares onset at 2 s for individual files.

filtering_metadata.reason: Specific acquisition cutoff and raw-file offline processing not located; previous-protocol smoothing not substituted.

measurement_units.reason: Published summary uses physiological mV, but no explicit raw-MAT units/conversion statement located.

preparation.reason: Published in vivo behaving tethered whole-cell current-clamp; reporting summary resolves female 3–7 days. Referenced method provides soma protocol, not file-specific deviations.

cell_identity.reason: GF targeting and panel-specific VT042336-GAL4/membrane-marker genotypes documented; neuron-type correspondence only.

source_condition.reason: Natural looming conditions and control/null/RNAi groups known; not matched measured LC4/LPLC2 source activation.

resolution.gate_scope: Selected individual Fig3/Ext8 files; combined array is not promoted through these individual-file gates.
resolution.interpretation: Meaningful trial/group and cohort metadata resolved, but no previously UNKNOWN target-voltage gate becomes PASS. Raw scale/filter/processing remain material blockers; no readiness upgrade justified.
resolution.preferred_future_representation: Individual trial-labelled MAT arrays, condition dictionary and genotype controls kept separate; not undocumented combined_T.
limitations: Type-level GF compatibility is not exact MaleCNS identity
Female 3–7-day recordings versus male connectome requires future explicit compatibility limits
Natural looming is not source-matched presynaptic activation
Summary mV labels do not certify raw array units
Observation transforms and biological source-state scale remain absent
resolution.next_action: Request a single author-confirmed export/acquisition dictionary covering stored voltage units/conversion/filtering and combined_T axes/processing, with file-specific protocol/version mapping; no fitting or external contact in this phase.
